name: Project create-time hook
description: On every container create, runs the project's own devc-post-create.sh if it has one — first .devc/devc-post-create.sh, then .devcontainer/devc-post-create.sh, first hit wins. Existence selects and executability is enforced: a hook that exists either runs or fails the create, never silently skipped. No mount, no host state, no network, no options — "project-hook": {} is the complete install; the whole of what a consumer adds is a committed, executable script in their own repo.
